title: GSAT Satellite Application
definition: GSAT (Geostationary Satellite) series comprises India's indigenous, advanced communication satellites developed by ISRO to achieve self-reliance in broadcasting, telecommunications, meteorological observations, and strategic defense applications.
importanceInUpsc: Directly tested in Prelims (specific satellite names, launch vehicles, orbital parameters, band frequencies) and Mains GS-3 (Science & Technology - achievements of Indians in science & technology; indigenous technology and development of new technology).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of GSAT Satellite Application.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Electromagnetic spectrum and frequency bands (C, Ku, Ka, S-band)
